description.zh-CN: 岛上多一个监控页：CPU 和每个核心、GPU（任何显卡的占用和引擎，NVIDIA 另有温度和功耗）、内存、上下行网速、电池，以及最占 CPU 和内存的程序；收起条上可以放 CPU、内存和温度。只在页面打开或收起条显示时读取（也可以选择在后台记录曲线），不需要管理员权限，不联网。用 Windows 自带的 PowerShell 运行。
description.en: Adds a monitor page: CPU and each core, the GPU (load and engines of any GPU; temperature and power on NVIDIA), memory, network speed, the battery and the programs using the most CPU and memory; CPU, memory and temperatures can also show on the collapsed bar. Reads only while the page is open or the bar shows figures (or, if you choose, records the charts in the background), needs no administrator rights and never goes online. Runs on the PowerShell built into Windows.

title.zh-CN: 收起条显示 CPU 占用
title.en: CPU load on the collapsed bar
Memory use on the collapsed bar

title.zh-CN: 收起条显示 CPU 温度
title.en: CPU temperature on the collapsed bar

description.zh-CN: 取 ACPI 温度区里最热的一个；很多台式机没有，会显示 -。
description.en: The hottest ACPI thermal zone; many desktops have none and show -.

title.zh-CN: 收起条显示 GPU 温度
title.en: GPU temperature on the collapsed bar

description.zh-CN: 只支持 NVIDIA 显卡。插件没在运行时，勾选后打开一次监控页或重启岛屿才会显示。
description.en: NVIDIA GPUs only. If the plugin is not running, the bar shows the figures after you open the monitor page once or restart the island.

title.en: Record the charts in the background

description.zh-CN: 监控页关着时也每秒读一次 CPU、GPU 和网速，打开页面时曲线带着最近五分钟。插件会一直运行，多一个约 80 MB 的 PowerShell 进程。
description.en: Reads CPU, GPU and network every second while the page is closed, so the charts show the last five minutes when it opens. The plugin then keeps running: one PowerShell process of about 80 MB.
